/* ===================== Stockage local + sauvegardes ===================== */
const DB_KEY = "dupclim:db:v3";
function loadDB() {
  try {
    const s = localStorage.getItem(DB_KEY);
    return s ? JSON.parse(s) : null;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}
function saveDB(db) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(db));
  } catch (e) {}
}
/* ----------------------- Synchronisation (Gist GitHub) ------------------ */
const SK_TOKEN = "dupclim:gh_token",
  SK_GIST = "dupclim:gist_id",
  SK_LAST = "dupclim:last_sync",
  GH_FILE = "dupclim-data.json";
function skGet(k) {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(k) || "";
  } catch (e) {
    return "";
  }
}
function skSet(k, v) {
  try {
    if (v) localStorage.setItem(k, v);else localStorage.removeItem(k);
  } catch (e) {}
}
async function ghApi(token, path, opts) {
  const r = await fetch("https://api.github.com" + path, Object.assign({
    headers: {
      "Authorization": "Bearer " + token,
      "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28"
    }
  }, opts || {}));
  if (!r.ok) {
    const e = new Error("GitHub " + r.status);
    e.status = r.status;
    throw e;
  }
  return r.status === 204 ? null : r.json();
}
async function gistFind(token) {
  const list = await ghApi(token, "/gists?per_page=100");
  for (const g of list) {
    if (g.files && g.files[GH_FILE]) return g.id;
  }
  return "";
}
async function gistRead(token, id) {
  const g = await ghApi(token, "/gists/" + id);
  const fo = g.files && g.files[GH_FILE];
  if (!fo) return null;
  let c = fo.content;
  if (fo.truncated && fo.raw_url) {
    c = await (await fetch(fo.raw_url)).text();
  }
  try {
    return JSON.parse(c);
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}
async function gistCreate(token, db) {
  const g = await ghApi(token, "/gists", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({
      description: "DUPCLIM — données",
      public: false,
      files: {
        [GH_FILE]: {
          content: JSON.stringify(db)
        }
      }
    })
  });
  return g.id;
}
async function gistWrite(token, id, db) {
  await ghApi(token, "/gists/" + id, {
    method: "PATCH",
    body: JSON.stringify({
      files: {
        [GH_FILE]: {
          content: JSON.stringify(db)
        }
      }
    })
  });
}
function downloadBackup(db) {
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(db, null, 2)], {
    type: "application/json"
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = "dupclim-sauvegarde-" + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + ".json";
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

/* ================================ Helpers =============================== */
const uid = (p = "id") => `${p}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
const APP_VERSION = "4.2";
const todayISO = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
function fmtDate(iso) {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  return new Date(iso + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString("fr-FR", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric"
  });
}
function addMonths(iso, m) {
  if (!iso || !m) return null;
  const d = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00");
  d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + Number(m));
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}
function daysUntil(iso) {
  if (!iso) return null;
  const d = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00").getTime();
  return Math.round((d - new Date(todayISO() + "T00:00:00").getTime()) / 86400000);
}

function nextDueFor(eq, interventions) {
  if (!eq.frequenceMois) return null;
  const ent = interventions.filter(i => i.equipementId === eq.id && i.type === "Entretien périodique").sort((a, b) => a.date < b.date ? 1 : -1);
  const base = ent[0]?.date || eq.dateInstallation;
  return addMonths(base, eq.frequenceMois);
}
function statutEcheance(iso) {
  const d = daysUntil(iso);
  if (d === null) return {
    key: "none",
    label: "Non planifié",
    cls: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500"
  };
  if (d < 0) return {
    key: "late",
    label: "En retard",
    cls: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700"
  };
  if (d <= 30) return {
    key: "soon",
    label: "Bientôt",
    cls: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700"
  };
  return {
    key: "ok",
    label: "À jour",
    cls: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700"
  };
}

function compressImage(file, maxDim = 1280, quality = 0.72) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      let w = img.naturalWidth,
        h = img.naturalHeight;
      if (w > maxDim || h > maxDim) {
        if (w >= h) {
          h = Math.round(h * maxDim / w);
          w = maxDim;
        } else {
          w = Math.round(w * maxDim / h);
          h = maxDim;
        }
      }
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = w;
      c.height = h;
      const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      try {
        resolve(c.toDataURL("image/jpeg", quality));
      } catch (e) {
        reject(e);
      }
    };
    img.onerror = () => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      reject(new Error("Image illisible"));
    };
    img.src = url;
  });
}

function processLogo(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      let w = img.naturalWidth,
        h = img.naturalHeight;
      const m = 420;
      if (w > m || h > m) {
        if (w >= h) {
          h = Math.round(h * m / w);
          w = m;
        } else {
          w = Math.round(w * m / h);
          h = m;
        }
      }
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = w;
      c.height = h;
      c.getContext("2d").drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      try {
        resolve(c.toDataURL("image/png"));
      } catch (e) {
        reject(e);
      }
    };
    img.onerror = () => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      reject(new Error("Image illisible"));
    };
    img.src = url;
  });
}

async function buildToolReportPdf(t, logo) {
  const {

    font: bold,
    color: slate
  });

    x: M,
    y: y - 28,
    size: 9.5,
    font: font,
    color: sky
  });
  page.drawText("79 Avenue Champ Rollet - 33610 Cestas", {
    x: M,
    y: y - 40,
    size: 8.5,
    font: font,
    color: grey
  });
  page.drawText("N° attestation de capacite : 198504", {
    x: M,
    y: y - 51,
    size: 8.5,
    font: font,

    y: y - 12,
    size: 12,
    font: bold,
    color: dark
  });

  const fmt = iso => iso ? new Date(iso + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString("fr-FR") : "—";

    height: cardH,
    color: cardbg,
    borderColor: light,
    borderWidth: 1

  let ry = y - 15;
  rows.forEach(r => {
    page.drawText(san(r[0]), {
      x: M + 10,
      y: ry,
      size: 9,
      font: bold,
      color: slate
    });
    page.drawText(san(r[1]), {
      x: M + 175,
      y: ry,
      size: 9,
      font: font,
      color: dark
    });
    ry -= 15;
  });
  y -= cardH + 20;
  page.drawRectangle({
    x: M,
    y: y - 14,
    width: 3.5,

  });

  y -= 22;

  page.drawText("N.C.", {

    y: y - 9,
    size: 7.5,

  });
  page.drawText("N/A", {

    size: 7.5,
    font: bold,
    color: grey
  });
  y -= 14;
  TOOL_CHECK.forEach(item => {
    page.drawText(san("- " + item), {

      font: font,
      color: dark

    [cx1, cx2, cx3].forEach(cx => page.drawRectangle({

      width: 10,
      height: 10,

      borderWidth: 0.8
    }));
    y -= 17;
  });
  y -= 6;
  page.drawText("Résultat :", {

    y: y - 10,
    size: 10,

    color: slate
  });
  page.drawRectangle({

    height: 11,

  });
  page.drawText("Conforme à l'usage", {

    size: 9,
    font: font,
    color: dark
  });
  page.drawRectangle({

    width: 11,
    height: 11,

    borderWidth: 0.9
  });
  page.drawText("Non conforme (hors service)", {
    x: M + 246,
    y: y - 9,
    size: 9,
    font: font,
    color: dark
  });
  y -= 26;
  if (t.observations) {
    page.drawText(san("Observations : " + t.observations).slice(0, 110), {
      x: M,
      y: y - 10,
      size: 9,
      font: font,
      color: dark
    });
    y -= 18;
  }
  page.drawText("Vérificateur : " + san(t.verificateur || "…………………………………"), {
    x: M,
    y: y - 12,
    size: 9.5,
    font: font,
    color: dark
  });
  page.drawText("Date de vérification : ……… / ……… / ………", {
    x: M,
    y: y - 32,
    size: 9.5,
    font: font,
    color: dark
  });
  const bx = W - M - 175;
  page.drawRectangle({
    x: bx,
    y: y - 74,
    width: 175,
    height: 64,
    borderColor: light,
    borderWidth: 1
  });
  page.drawText("Signature du vérificateur", {
    x: bx + 8,
    y: y - 20,
    size: 8,
    font: bold,
    color: grey
  });
  page.drawLine({
    start: {
      x: M,
      y: M + 16
    },
    end: {
      x: W - M,
      y: M + 16
    },
    thickness: 0.6,
    color: light
  });
  page.drawText("ETS DUPIN - 79 Avenue Champ Rollet - 33610 Cestas - N° attestation 198504", {
    x: M,
    y: M + 5,
    size: 7.5,
    font: font,
    color: grey
  });
  page.drawText("Édité le " + new Date().toLocaleDateString("fr-FR"), {
    x: W - M - 90,
    y: M + 5,
    size: 7.5,
    font: font,
    color: grey
  });
  return await doc.save();
}
